Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. legislation (n)
/ˌledʒɪsˈleɪʃn/
luật pháp, hệ thống đạo luật do quốc hội/chính phủ ban hành (không đếm được)
Collocation: introduce new legislation, strict legislation
"The government introduced strict legislation to protect citizens from online fraud."
2. offense (n)
/əˈfens/
hành vi phạm pháp, tội danh (từ học thuật thay cho crime)
Collocation: commit an offense, minor offense, serious offense
"Driving without a valid license is a serious traffic offense in every country."
3. deterrent (n)
/dɪˈterənt/
biện pháp răn đe, ngăn chặn hành vi phạm tội trước khi nó xảy ra
Collocation: act as a deterrent, effective deterrent against crime
"Heavy fines act as a strong deterrent against illegal littering and pollution."
4. rehabilitate (v)
/ˌriːəˈbɪlɪteɪt/
cải tạo, giáo dục phục hồi để người lầm lỗi tái hòa nhập xã hội (n: rehabilitation)
Collocation: rehabilitate prisoners, vocational rehabilitation
"Prisons should focus on educating and rehabilitating offenders rather than merely punishing them."
5. offender (n)
/əˈfendə(r)/
người phạm pháp, kẻ vi phạm pháp luật
Collocation: first-time offender, repeat offender, young offender
"Community service is often more suitable than prison for a first-time offender."
6. juvenile (adj/n)
/ˈdʒuːvənaɪl/
thuộc về vị thành niên (dưới 18 tuổi)
Collocation: juvenile crime, juvenile delinquency
"Supportive family upbringing and after-school sports help reduce juvenile delinquency."
7. surveillance (n)
/sɜːˈveɪləns/
sự giám sát an ninh (đặc biệt qua hệ thống camera công cộng)
Collocation: video surveillance, surveillance camera, under surveillance
"Installing street lighting and surveillance cameras makes city parks much safer at night."
8. penalty (n)
/ˈpenəlti/
hình phạt, mức phạt theo quy định pháp luật
Collocation: severe penalty, financial penalty, impose a penalty
"Corporations that dump toxic waste into rivers must face severe financial penalties."
9. enforce (v)
/ɪnˈfɔːs/
thực thi, cưỡng chế chấp hành luật pháp (n: law enforcement)
Collocation: enforce the law, strictly enforce regulations
"Traffic police use speed cameras to enforce road safety laws on highways."
10. cybercrime (n)
/ˈsaɪbəkraɪm/
tội phạm mạng (lừa đảo trực tuyến, đánh cắp dữ liệu, tấn công mạng)
Collocation: combat cybercrime, rise in cybercrime
"As digital banking grows, police departments need technical experts to combat cybercrime."
11. victim (n)
/ˈvɪktɪm/
nạn nhân (của tội phạm, tai nạn hoặc lừa đảo)
Collocation: innocent victim, fall victim to
"Elderly people who are unfamiliar with the internet sometimes fall victim to phone scams."
12. verdict (n)
/ˈvɜːdɪkt/
phán quyết của tòa án hoặc bồi thẩm đoàn
Collocation: reach a verdict, guilty verdict
"After examining all the evidence carefully, the court reached a fair verdict."
13. prevent (v)
/prɪˈvent/
ngăn ngừa, phòng chống (prevent sb/sth from V-ing)
Collocation: prevent crime, crime prevention
"Providing equal job opportunities is the most sustainable way to prevent crime."
14. poverty (n)
/ˈpɒvəti/
sự nghèo đói, thiếu thốn kinh tế
Collocation: reduce poverty, live in poverty
"Sociologists point out that unemployment and poverty are major root causes of street crime."
15. justice (n)
/ˈdʒʌstɪs/
công lý, sự công bằng của pháp luật; hệ thống tư pháp
Collocation: criminal justice system, social justice, law-abiding citizen
"A fair justice system protects law-abiding citizens and upholds human rights."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Cấu Trúc Mục Đích Học Thuật (So That / In Order To) & Prevent ... From V-ing

• in order to / so as to + V (nguyên mẫu): Diễn tả mục đích của chính phủ/pháp luật một cách trang trọng.
  Ví dụ: Governments install public surveillance cameras in order to deter potential offenders.

• so that / in order that + S + can/will/would + V: Nối mệnh đề mục đích.
  Ví dụ: Prisons should provide vocational training so that former offenders can find honest employment.

• prevent / deter + Object + from + V-ing: Ngăn chặn ai làm điều gì.
  Ví dụ: Strict penalties prevent corporations from polluting the environment.

🔵 Tầng 2: Trạng Từ Kết Quả 'Thereby + V-ing' & Bị Động Với Động Từ Khuyết Thiếu

• Cấu trúc , thereby + V-ing (Qua đó / Nhờ đó dẫn đến kết quả là... — Cấu trúc C1 đắt giá cho Task 2):
  Ví dụ: Schools should teach cybersecurity awareness, thereby protecting students from becoming victims of cybercrime.

• Bị động với Modal Verbs trong Luật pháp: must / should / ought to + be + V3/ed
  Ví dụ: Traffic legislation must be strictly enforced to ensure public safety.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Parliament passed new environmental ________ to ban single-use toxic chemicals.
2. Driving under the influence of alcohol is a serious ________ that endangers innocent lives.
3. Visible police patrols on city streets act as a powerful ________ against robbery.
4. Vocational classes in prison help ________ inmates so they can work legally after release.
5. A first-time ________ who commits a minor shoplifting crime may be given community service.
6. Youth clubs and free sports facilities play a vital role in reducing ________ delinquency.
7. High-definition ________ cameras at banks and train stations help police identify suspects quickly.
8. The maximum ________ for hacking into government databases is ten years in prison.
9. Passing good laws is useless unless the police have enough resources to ________ them fairly.
10. Phishing emails and online identity theft are common forms of modern ________.
11. The charity provides free legal advice and counseling to any ________ of domestic violence.
12. After three days of deliberation, the jury returned a 'not guilty' ________.
13. Educating citizens about strong passwords can ________ hackers from stealing bank accounts.
14. Investing in public education and job creation helps lift disadvantaged families out of ________.
15. Every citizen deserves equal treatment under the criminal ________ system, regardless of wealth.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 14] Two-factor authentication protects every online banking ________ from cybercrime.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 13] Consumer protection laws ban false commercials that try to ________ buyers.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 12] Government ________ on public education and policing increased by 12% this year.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 11] Prisoners who gain a vocational ________ have a much better chance of finding a job.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Parents have a legal and moral ________ to guide their children during adolescence.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Strict cybersecurity legislation must ________ to protect citizens from online scams.
2. High-definition surveillance cameras are installed in city centres in order ________ street crime.
3. Heavy financial penalties prevent industrial corporations from ________ toxic waste into rivers.
4. Prisons provide vocational training courses ________ former offenders can earn an honest living.
5. Governments should invest in youth sports centres, thereby ________ juvenile delinquency.
6. Note that legislation is an uncountable noun: New legislation ________ passed last month to combat cybercrime.
7. First-time juvenile offenders ought to ________ through education rather than sent to adult prisons.
8. If poverty and unemployment ________ reduced, the overall crime rate would fall dramatically.
9. Offenders ________ commit violent crimes must face severe penalties to protect law-abiding citizens.
10. Between 2015 and 2025, reported cases of online fraud surged ________ 45%, whereas street robbery declined.
Điểm: 0/10

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Role of Strict Legislation and Deterrence]
For centuries, governments have debated the most effective way to maintain social order and uphold justice. Traditionalists argue that strict legislation and severe prison penalties are essential because they act as a powerful deterrent. When potential criminals know that the police will strictly enforce the law and that courts will deliver a tough verdict, they are less likely to commit a serious offense. In addition, installing public surveillance cameras helps protect innocent victims in urban areas.

[Paragraph B - Addressing Root Causes and Rehabilitating Offenders]
However, criminologists point out that long prison sentences alone do not solve the root causes of crime, such as poverty, unemployment, and lack of education. If a first-time or juvenile offender is locked up with hardened criminals without any support, they often reoffend after leaving prison. Therefore, modern justice systems invest heavily in programs designed to rehabilitate prisoners through vocational training, psychological counseling, and literacy classes.

[Paragraph C - Preventing Modern Cybercrime]
In the twenty-first century, law enforcement also faces the rapid rise of cybercrime, including online banking fraud and identity theft. To prevent these digital offenses, governments must combine international police cooperation with public education, thereby empowering citizens to protect their personal data online.
Điểm: 0/6
